## PR Description

Part of #1267

## Slice delivered: N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg (AC1)

By #177 design the ubuntu PR leg never *exercises* the JS-engine suites: `flutter_app/test/apps/**` run there, but every engine-dependent test **skips** (`native_test_guard.dart` finds no QuickJS `.so` on a bare runner). That surface executed **only** in the nightly macOS leg — the hole **#1309** escaped through (gh-1307: #1273's engine fix merged green and went red the same night; gh-1266 is the same class). This PR closes that hole pre-merge:

- **New `flutter-app-exzone` leg**: `macos-latest`, runs `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` where JavaScriptCore actually loads — the guard resolves true, so the engine-dependent tests *run* instead of skip. Same SDK/placeholder incantation as nightly's `flutter-app-macos` leg; 25 min cap.
- **Trigger model — dispatch-only CI (gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom, per review)**: ci.yml has **no `pull_request` trigger** — PR validation arrives as an SM `workflow_dispatch` on the head SHA. The leg therefore fires in **every SM validation dispatch** (path-blind; one hosted-macOS leg beside the `build-macos`/`build-ios` legs already paid there), and the `exzone` path set (`flutter_app/lib/apps/**`, `lib/src/js_ext/**`, the guarded family, `native_test_guard.dart`, the `js_widget_runtime` pin in `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml`) is labelled **path-narrowing reserve** — it only narrows if a real `pull_request` trigger ever lands. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip (nightly `flutter-app-macos` stays the full-suite backstop there).
- **Quality gate**: folded into the aggregate `needs` + report + fail-loop (skip-tolerant like every path-gated leg) → AC1's *required-and-green* via the repo's one-required-check design. A red exzone = red gate = no merge.
- Docs de-overstated to the dispatch model: ci.yml header leg inventory, the job's own comment, classifier/output comments, and AGENTS.md §Quality gates (AGENTS.md is agent-injected — the stated invariant must match reality).

**Path-mapping note:** the issue's `packages/js_widget_runtime/**` no longer exists in-repo — `js_widget_runtime: ^0.4.154` is an **external git dep** (IstiN/flutter_js_widget_runtime); its in-repo arrival surface is the `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` pin. A lockfile-only resolve is deliberately N2 territory, not this slice.

## Why this slice first

The body lists no explicit priority among N1–N4. N1 is the highest-value/lowest-risk: the only rule whose motivating incident **recurred after the issue was filed** (#1309/gh-1307); pure CI-config-as-code (no scheduling, no dispatch — SM/owner still own every run, §4b respected); no repo-state change (N2 commits a lockfile) and no bot/queue machinery (N3 filer, N4 merge snapshots).

## Remaining goal map (NOT in this PR)

- **N2** — commit `flutter_app/pubspec.lock`, `--enforce-lockfile` in every build leg, path-triggered linux+windows release-build smoke on lockfile changes (AC2).
- **N3** — nightly-red filer resurrection + escalation (AC3): the filer is silently dead since #466 closed 2026-09-18.
- **N4** — merge-snapshot gating + nightly test-leg elimination (AC5, owner directive): subsumes the #1282 dispatch-time binaries wiring per the issue comment. A dispatch-aware classifier (reviving the pending perf/intmock path-greps, issue #303) is the natural companion slice to N4 — declined here as separate scope.
- Closing #1267 also requires #1265 + #1266 closed (AC4).

## Verification (disclosure)

- **Trigger truth table** (ruby-YAML structural check): `workflow_dispatch` fires; future `pull_request`+zone fires; future PR-without-zone, `push`, `tag`, `schedule`, `release` all skip. All 28 `quality-gate` needs resolve; report + fail-loop wired.
- **Classifier grep** replayed against synthetic positives/negatives AND the real motivating diffs — #1273 (989dfbfff) and gh-1266 fix (38303cfbb) both match the path set.
- **Not verified here**: actual macOS leg execution — CI-dispatch ban (§4b); the leg runs when SM schedules this PR's validation. Step-for-step mirrors the nightly macos leg that already passes weekly. No dart/flutter executed on this host (EPERM/137 guard).

# pr-1350: ci(1267): path-triggered macOS exclusion-zone leg — JS-engine tests run pre-merge (N1, first slice)

## Description

Part of #1267

## Slice delivered: N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg (AC1)

By #177 design the ubuntu PR leg never *exercises* the JS-engine suites: `flutter_app/test/apps/**` run there, but every engine-dependent test **skips** (`native_test_guard.dart` finds no QuickJS `.so` on a bare runner). That surface executed **only** in the nightly macOS leg — the hole **#1309** escaped through (gh-1307: #1273's engine fix merged green and went red the same night; gh-1266 is the same class). This PR closes that hole pre-merge:

- **New `flutter-app-exzone` leg**: `macos-latest`, runs `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` where JavaScriptCore actually loads — the guard resolves true, so the engine-dependent tests *run* instead of skip. Same SDK/placeholder incantation as nightly's `flutter-app-macos` leg; 25 min cap.
- **Trigger model — dispatch-only CI (gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom, per review)**: ci.yml has **no `pull_request` trigger** — PR validation arrives as an SM `workflow_dispatch` on the head SHA. The leg therefore fires in **every SM validation dispatch** (path-blind; one hosted-macOS leg beside the `build-macos`/`build-ios` legs already paid there), and the `exzone` path set (`flutter_app/lib/apps/**`, `lib/src/js_ext/**`, the guarded family, `native_test_guard.dart`, the `js_widget_runtime` pin in `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml`) is labelled **path-narrowing reserve** — it only narrows if a real `pull_request` trigger ever lands. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip (nightly `flutter-app-macos` stays the full-suite backstop there).
- **Quality gate**: folded into the aggregate `needs` + report + fail-loop (skip-tolerant like every path-gated leg) → AC1's *required-and-green* via the repo's one-required-check design. A red exzone = red gate = no merge.
- Docs de-overstated to the dispatch model: ci.yml header leg inventory, the job's own comment, classifier/output comments, and AGENTS.md §Quality gates (AGENTS.md is agent-injected — the stated invariant must match reality).

**Path-mapping note:** the issue's `packages/js_widget_runtime/**` no longer exists in-repo — `js_widget_runtime: ^0.4.154` is an **external git dep** (IstiN/flutter_js_widget_runtime); its in-repo arrival surface is the `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` pin. A lockfile-only resolve is deliberately N2 territory, not this slice.

## Why this slice first

The body lists no explicit priority among N1–N4. N1 is the highest-value/lowest-risk: the only rule whose motivating incident **recurred after the issue was filed** (#1309/gh-1307); pure CI-config-as-code (no scheduling, no dispatch — SM/owner still own every run, §4b respected); no repo-state change (N2 commits a lockfile) and no bot/queue machinery (N3 filer, N4 merge snapshots).

## Remaining goal map (NOT in this PR)

- **N2** — commit `flutter_app/pubspec.lock`, `--enforce-lockfile` in every build leg, path-triggered linux+windows release-build smoke on lockfile changes (AC2).
- **N3** — nightly-red filer resurrection + escalation (AC3): the filer is silently dead since #466 closed 2026-09-18.
- **N4** — merge-snapshot gating + nightly test-leg elimination (AC5, owner directive): subsumes the #1282 dispatch-time binaries wiring per the issue comment. A dispatch-aware classifier (reviving the pending perf/intmock path-greps, issue #303) is the natural companion slice to N4 — declined here as separate scope.
- Closing #1267 also requires #1265 + #1266 closed (AC4).

## Verification (disclosure)

- **Trigger truth table** (ruby-YAML structural check): `workflow_dispatch` fires; future `pull_request`+zone fires; future PR-without-zone, `push`, `tag`, `schedule`, `release` all skip. All 28 `quality-gate` needs resolve; report + fail-loop wired.
- **Classifier grep** replayed against synthetic positives/negatives AND the real motivating diffs — #1273 (989dfbfff) and gh-1266 fix (38303cfbb) both match the path set.
- **Not verified here**: actual macOS leg execution — CI-dispatch ban (§4b); the leg runs when SM schedules this PR's validation. Step-for-step mirrors the nightly macos leg that already passes weekly. No dart/flutter executed on this host (EPERM/137 guard).
- **Review round 1**: bot CHANGES_REQUESTED (dead-code classifier, green-by-skip leg, overstated docs) — all three threads fixed/answered in dc37d9cff.

# PR Discussion History

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-07):
🚨 **BLOCKING: `flutter-app-exzone` can never run — the required check stays green-by-skip and the gh-1307 hole this PR targets remains open**

This workflow has **no `pull_request` trigger** (dispatch-only CI, 2026-09 machine-loop redesign): PR validation runs arrive as `workflow_dispatch` events fired by the SM (`machine-sm.yml` passes `ci-workflow: ci.yml`), so `github.event_name` is **never** `'pull_request'` on a validation run.

Consequences for this job:

- The `exzone` output is computed only inside the `paths` classifier step, which is gated `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'` (ci.yml:131) — that step **never executes**. Unlike `core`/`app`/`docs`/`shared`, the output has no `|| steps.filter...` fallback arm either.
- So `needs.changes.outputs.exzone` is empty on **every** event this workflow can fire on (SM validation dispatches, main pushes, tags, schedule, release) → this job always evaluates `'' == 'true'` → **skipped**, every time.
- `quality-gate` is skip-tolerant (`"flutter-app-exzone:$R_EXZONE"` accepts `skipped`), so the aggregate stays green while the JS-engine surface keeps skipping exactly as before. This is the **same green-by-skip bug gh-1280 fixed for `binaries-pr`** ("a broken arch build could never block a merge") and the same latent bug documented for `perf-gate` in the `usage-fold` comment (issue #303).

Net effect: the PR does not deliver AC1 — #1309-class regressions still merge green.

**Fix** — use the idiom this file already established for dispatch-only CI (`binaries-pr`, gh-1280):

```yaml
  flutter-app-exzone:
    ...
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true') ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
```

This runs the leg on every SM validation dispatch (where the classifier's non-PR filter arm already treats everything as affected and `build-macos`/`build-ios`/`binaries-pr` macOS legs already run, so the marginal cost is one hosted-macOS leg) and keeps path-narrowing for any future real `pull_request` trigger. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it — the nightly `flutter-app-macos` leg remains the backstop there, matching the stated design.

(Alternative: the `usage-fold` form `github.event_name != 'pull_request' || needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true'` — but that also fires the macOS leg on every main push, tag, release and 2-hour release-catch-up schedule tick, which is paid coverage nightly already provides.)

---

### Thread 2 — `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-07):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: this classifier block is dead code in this repo's event model**

The `exzone` output (line 107) and this grep block live inside the `paths` step gated `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'`, but ci.yml has **no `pull_request` trigger** — PR validation arrives via SM `workflow_dispatch`, and main/tag/schedule/release runs also aren't `pull_request` events. This block therefore never executes anywhere; the output can never be non-empty (there is no `|| steps.filter...` fallback like `core`/`app`/`docs`/`shared` have).

That means the path families encoded here (`flutter_app/lib/apps/`, `lib/src/js_ext/`, `flutter_app/test/apps/`, `native_test_guard.dart`, `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml`) are **not** actually what gates the new leg — see the BLOCKING thread on the job's `if`. As written, this block advertises a gating mechanism that cannot fire; it is the exact gh-1280 failure class (green-by-skip required context) already fixed once in this file.

Two acceptable directions:

1. Keep the block for a future real `pull_request` trigger, but fix the job's `if` to the `binaries-pr` dispatch idiom so the leg runs on validation dispatches (see BLOCKING thread), **or**
2. Make the classifier dispatch-aware (compute the diff base via merge-base against `origin/main` on `workflow_dispatch`, or have the filter arm compute it), which would revive path-narrowing here **and** fix the two pre-existing legs with the same latent bug: `perf-gate` (documented pending in the `usage-fold` comment, issue #303) and `integration-mock` (`if: needs.changes.outputs.intmock == 'true'` — also unreachable, so the #551 mock-LLM PR gate silently gates nothing under dispatch-only CI).

Either way, please don't merge this block as-is: it documents a trigger relationship that does not exist, which is worse than no block for future maintainers and agents reading this file.

blocks.text:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['v*']
  # Dispatch-only CI on PR heads (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes
  # fire NO CI — the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger.
  # It dispatches this workflow on the PR head when validation is due
  # (validate-fresh / validate-armed rules), so intermediate dev/rework
  # pushes and silent branch updates are free. Required checks still
  # match: the dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      releaseDryRun:
        description: 'gh-1172: run the release pipeline without the push/tag (logs the commit+tag that WOULD land)'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      releaseDispatch:
        description: 'gh-1172: real release (bump push + tag) on manual dispatch — requires refs/heads/main; bare validation dispatches stay inert'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
  # Any release publication (API `gh release create`, web UI, or a pushed
  # annotated tag) builds + attaches the binaries matrix. Pushed tags also
  # arrive via the push filter above; the binaries job tolerates the
  # double-fire (duplicate create + --clobber upload, last wins).
  release:
    types: [published]
  schedule:
    # Coalesced auto-release catch-up: when pushes outpace the 2h coalesce
    # window, this releases the pending commits (pub.dev caps ~12 publishes/day).
    - cron: '23 */2 * * *'

# Superseded PR runs die instantly (issue #177 wave 1). Main/tag runs are
# never cancelled mid-flight — release flow must not be preempted.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Issue #1267 N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg. By #177 design the ubuntu
  # PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night). When
  # a PR touches the exclusion zone (flutter_app/lib/apps/**,
  # lib/src/js_ext/**, the guarded family, the guard itself, or the external
  # js_widget_runtime pin in flutter_app/pubspec.yaml), this macos leg runs
  # the family pre-merge, where JavaScriptCore actually loads. Rare paths →
  # one cheap runner; every other PR pays nothing. Nightly keeps the
  # full-suite macOS backstop; merge-blocking flows through the aggregate
  # Quality gate (a red exzone = red gate, AC1's required-and-green).
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Same SDK incantation as the nightly flutter-app-macos leg.
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app

          set -euo pipefail

          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=

      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)

**Why it can never run.** This workflow has **no `pull_request` trigger** (dispatch-only CI, 2026-09 machine-loop redesign — see the `on:` block: push/workflow_dispatch/release/schedule only). PR validation arrives as `workflow_dispatch` fired by the SM (`machine-sm.yml` passes `ci-workflow: ci.yml`), so `github.event_name` is never `'pull_request'` on a validation run.     ...

      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true') ||

```

## PR Description

Part of #1267

## Slice delivered: N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg (AC1)

By #177 design the ubuntu PR leg never *exercises* the JS-engine suites: `flutter_app/test/apps/**` run there, but every engine-dependent test **skips** (`native_test_guard.dart` finds no QuickJS `.so` on a bare runner). That surface executed **only** in the nightly macOS leg — the hole **#1309** escaped through (gh-1307: #1273's engine fix merged green and went red the same night; gh-1266 is the same class). This PR closes that hole pre-merge:

- **New `flutter-app-exzone` leg**: `macos-latest`, runs `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` where JavaScriptCore actually loads — the guard resolves true, so the engine-dependent tests *run* instead of skip. Same SDK/placeholder incantation as nightly's `flutter-app-macos` leg; 25 min cap.
- **Trigger model — dispatch-only CI (gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom, per review)**: ci.yml has **no `pull_request` trigger** — PR validation arrives as an SM `workflow_dispatch` on the head SHA. The leg therefore fires in **every SM validation dispatch** (path-blind; one hosted-macOS leg beside the `build-macos`/`build-ios` legs already paid there), and the `exzone` path set (`flutter_app/lib/apps/**`, `lib/src/js_ext/**`, the guarded family, `native_test_guard.dart`, the `js_widget_runtime` pin in `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml`) is labelled **path-narrowing reserve** — it only narrows if a real `pull_request` trigger ever lands. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip (nightly `flutter-app-macos` stays the full-suite backstop there).
- **Quality gate**: folded into the aggregate `needs` + report + fail-loop (skip-tolerant like every path-gated leg) → AC1's *required-and-green* via the repo's one-required-check design. A red exzone = red gate = no merge.
- Docs de-overstated to the dispatch model: ci.yml header leg inventory, the job's own comment, classifier/output comments, and AGENTS.md §Quality gates (AGENTS.md is agent-injected — the stated invariant must match reality).

**Path-mapping note:** the issue's `packages/js_widget_runtime/**` no longer exists in-repo — `js_widget_runtime: ^0.4.154` is an **external git dep** (IstiN/flutter_js_widget_runtime); its in-repo arrival surface is the `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` pin. A lockfile-only resolve is deliberately N2 territory, not this slice.

## Why this slice first

The body lists no explicit priority among N1–N4. N1 is the highest-value/lowest-risk: the only rule whose motivating incident **recurred after the issue was filed** (#1309/gh-1307); pure CI-config-as-code (no scheduling, no dispatch — SM/owner still own every run, §4b respected); no repo-state change (N2 commits a lockfile) and no bot/queue machinery (N3 filer, N4 merge snapshots).

## Remaining goal map (NOT in this PR)

- **N2** — commit `flutter_app/pubspec.lock`, `--enforce-lockfile` in every build leg, path-triggered linux+windows release-build smoke on lockfile changes (AC2).
- **N3** — nightly-red filer resurrection + escalation (AC3): the filer is silently dead since #466 closed 2026-09-18.
- **N4** — merge-snapshot gating + nightly test-leg elimination (AC5, owner directive): subsumes the #1282 dispatch-time binaries wiring per the issue comment. A dispatch-aware classifier (reviving the pending perf/intmock path-greps, issue #303) is the natural companion slice to N4 — declined here as separate scope.
- Closing #1267 also requires #1265 + #1266 closed (AC4).

## Verification (disclosure)

- **Trigger truth table** (ruby-YAML structural check): `workflow_dispatch` fires; future `pull_request`+zone fires; future PR-without-zone, `push`, `tag`, `schedule`, `release` all skip. All 28 `quality-gate` needs resolve; report + fail-loop wired.
- **Classifier grep** replayed against synthetic positives/negatives AND the real motivating diffs — #1273 (989dfbfff) and gh-1266 fix (38303cfbb) both match the path set.
- **Not verified here**: actual macOS leg execution — CI-dispatch ban (§4b); the leg runs when SM schedules this PR's validation. Step-for-step mirrors the nightly macos leg that already passes weekly. No dart/flutter executed on this host (EPERM/137 guard).
- **Review round 1**: bot CHANGES_REQUESTED (dead-code classifier, green-by-skip leg, overstated docs) — all three threads fixed/answered in dc37d9cff.

# pr-1350: ci(1267): path-triggered macOS exclusion-zone leg — JS-engine tests run pre-merge (N1, first slice)

## Description

Part of #1267

## Slice delivered: N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg (AC1)

By #177 design the ubuntu PR leg never *exercises* the JS-engine suites: `flutter_app/test/apps/**` run there, but every engine-dependent test **skips** (`native_test_guard.dart` finds no QuickJS `.so` on a bare runner). That surface executed **only** in the nightly macOS leg — the hole **#1309** escaped through (gh-1307: #1273's engine fix merged green and went red the same night; gh-1266 is the same class). This PR closes that hole pre-merge:

- **New `flutter-app-exzone` leg**: `macos-latest`, runs `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` where JavaScriptCore actually loads — the guard resolves true, so the engine-dependent tests *run* instead of skip. Same SDK/placeholder incantation as nightly's `flutter-app-macos` leg; 25 min cap.
- **Trigger model — dispatch-only CI (gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom, per review)**: ci.yml has **no `pull_request` trigger** — PR validation arrives as an SM `workflow_dispatch` on the head SHA. The leg therefore fires in **every SM validation dispatch** (path-blind; one hosted-macOS leg beside the `build-macos`/`build-ios` legs already paid there), and the `exzone` path set (`flutter_app/lib/apps/**`, `lib/src/js_ext/**`, the guarded family, `native_test_guard.dart`, the `js_widget_runtime` pin in `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml`) is labelled **path-narrowing reserve** — it only narrows if a real `pull_request` trigger ever lands. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip (nightly `flutter-app-macos` stays the full-suite backstop there).
- **Quality gate**: folded into the aggregate `needs` + report + fail-loop (skip-tolerant like every path-gated leg) → AC1's *required-and-green* via the repo's one-required-check design. A red exzone = red gate = no merge.
- Docs de-overstated to the dispatch model: ci.yml header leg inventory, the job's own comment, classifier/output comments, and AGENTS.md §Quality gates (AGENTS.md is agent-injected — the stated invariant must match reality).

**Path-mapping note:** the issue's `packages/js_widget_runtime/**` no longer exists in-repo — `js_widget_runtime: ^0.4.154` is an **external git dep** (IstiN/flutter_js_widget_runtime); its in-repo arrival surface is the `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` pin. A lockfile-only resolve is deliberately N2 territory, not this slice.

## Why this slice first

The body lists no explicit priority among N1–N4. N1 is the highest-value/lowest-risk: the only rule whose motivating incident **recurred after the issue was filed** (#1309/gh-1307); pure CI-config-as-code (no scheduling, no dispatch — SM/owner still own every run, §4b respected); no repo-state change (N2 commits a lockfile) and no bot/queue machinery (N3 filer, N4 merge snapshots).

## Remaining goal map (NOT in this PR)

- **N2** — commit `flutter_app/pubspec.lock`, `--enforce-lockfile` in every build leg, path-triggered linux+windows release-build smoke on lockfile changes (AC2).
- **N3** — nightly-red filer resurrection + escalation (AC3): the filer is silently dead since #466 closed 2026-09-18.
- **N4** — merge-snapshot gating + nightly test-leg elimination (AC5, owner directive): subsumes the #1282 dispatch-time binaries wiring per the issue comment. A dispatch-aware classifier (reviving the pending perf/intmock path-greps, issue #303) is the natural companion slice to N4 — declined here as separate scope.
- Closing #1267 also requires #1265 + #1266 closed (AC4).

## Verification (disclosure)

- **Trigger truth table** (ruby-YAML structural check): `workflow_dispatch` fires; future `pull_request`+zone fires; future PR-without-zone, `push`, `tag`, `schedule`, `release` all skip. All 28 `quality-gate` needs resolve; report + fail-loop wired.
- **Classifier grep** replayed against synthetic positives/negatives AND the real motivating diffs — #1273 (989dfbfff) and gh-1266 fix (38303cfbb) both match the path set.
- **Not verified here**: actual macOS leg execution — CI-dispatch ban (§4b); the leg runs when SM schedules this PR's validation. Step-for-step mirrors the nightly macos leg that already passes weekly. No dart/flutter executed on this host (EPERM/137 guard).
- **Review round 1**: bot CHANGES_REQUESTED (dead-code classifier, green-by-skip leg, overstated docs) — all three threads fixed/answered in dc37d9cff.

## Description

Part of #1267

## Slice delivered: N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg (AC1)

By #177 design the ubuntu PR leg never *exercises* the JS-engine suites: `flutter_app/test/apps/**` run there, but every engine-dependent test **skips** (`native_test_guard.dart` finds no QuickJS `.so` on a bare runner). That surface executed **only** in the nightly macOS leg — the hole **#1309** escaped through (gh-1307: #1273's engine fix merged green and went red the same night; gh-1266 is the same class). This PR closes that hole pre-merge, declaratively:

- **`changes` job**: new `exzone` output (same inline-grep pattern as `perf`/`usagefold`) — fires when a PR diff touches `flutter_app/lib/apps/**`, `lib/src/js_ext/**`, the guarded `flutter_app/test/apps/**` family, `flutter_app/test/native_test_guard.dart`, or `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` (the external `js_widget_runtime` pin — see path-mapping note).
- **New `flutter-app-exzone` leg**: `macos-latest`, runs `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` where JavaScriptCore actually loads — the guard resolves true, so the engine-dependent tests *run* instead of skip. Same SDK/placeholder incantation as nightly's `flutter-app-macos` leg; 25 min cap.
- **Quality gate**: folded into the aggregate `needs` + report + fail-loop (skip-tolerant like every path-gated leg) → AC1's *required-and-green* via the repo's one-required-check design. A PR touching only `lib/src/` core pays nothing.
- Docs: ci.yml header leg inventory + AGENTS.md §Quality gates.

**Path-mapping note (body vs repo @ 6d1a300):** the issue's `packages/js_widget_runtime/**` no longer exists in-repo — `js_widget_runtime: ^0.4.154` is an **external git dep** (IstiN/flutter_js_widget_runtime). Its in-repo arrival surface is the `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` pin, which the trigger covers; a lockfile-only resolve is deliberately N2 territory, not this slice.

## Why this slice first

The body lists no explicit priority among N1–N4. N1 is the highest-value/lowest-risk: it is the only rule whose motivating incident **recurred after the issue was filed** (#1309/gh-1307, fix commit be413ff5d); it is pure CI-config-as-code (path filters only — no scheduling, no dispatch; SM/owner pushes still own every run, §4b respected); and it needs no repo-state change (N2 commits a lockfile) nor new bot/queue machinery (N3 filer, N4 merge snapshots).

## Remaining goal map (NOT in this PR)

- **N2** — commit `flutter_app/pubspec.lock`, `--enforce-lockfile` in every build leg, path-triggered linux+windows release-build smoke on lockfile changes (AC2).
- **N3** — nightly-red filer resurrection + escalation (AC3): the filer is silently dead since #466 closed 2026-09-18; five red nights, zero trackers.
- **N4** — merge-snapshot gating + nightly test-leg elimination (AC5, owner directive 2026-10-05): merge queue or merge-bot-synthesized trees; subsumes the #1282 dispatch-time binaries wiring per the issue comment.
- Closing #1267 also requires #1265 + #1266 closed (AC4).

# PR Discussion History

_Previous review discussions for PR #1350._

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-07):
🚨 **BLOCKING: `flutter-app-exzone` can never run — the required check stays green-by-skip and the gh-1307 hole this PR targets remains open**

This workflow has **no `pull_request` trigger** (dispatch-only CI, 2026-09 machine-loop redesign): PR validation runs arrive as `workflow_dispatch` events fired by the SM (`machine-sm.yml` passes `ci-workflow: ci.yml`), so `github.event_name` is **never** `'pull_request'` on a validation run.

Consequences for this job:

- The `exzone` output is computed only inside the `paths` classifier step, which is gated `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'` (ci.yml:131) — that step **never executes**. Unlike `core`/`app`/`docs`/`shared`, the output has no `|| steps.filter...` fallback arm either.
- So `needs.changes.outputs.exzone` is empty on **every** event this workflow can fire on (SM validation dispatches, main pushes, tags, schedule, release) → this job always evaluates `'' == 'true'` → **skipped**, every time.
- `quality-gate` is skip-tolerant (`"flutter-app-exzone:$R_EXZONE"` accepts `skipped`), so the aggregate stays green while the JS-engine surface keeps skipping exactly as before. This is the **same green-by-skip bug gh-1280 fixed for `binaries-pr`** ("a broken arch build could never block a merge") and the same latent bug documented for `perf-gate` in the `usage-fold` comment (issue #303).

Net effect: the PR does not deliver AC1 — #1309-class regressions still merge green.

**Fix** — use the idiom this file already established for dispatch-only CI (`binaries-pr`, gh-1280):

```yaml
  flutter-app-exzone:
    ...
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true') ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
```

This runs the leg on every SM validation dispatch (where the classifier's non-PR filter arm already treats everything as affected and `build-macos`/`build-ios`/`binaries-pr` macOS legs already run, so the marginal cost is one hosted-macOS leg) and keeps path-narrowing for any future real `pull_request` trigger. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it — the nightly `flutter-app-macos` leg remains the backstop there, matching the stated design.

(Alternative: the `usage-fold` form `github.event_name != 'pull_request' || needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true'` — but that also fires the macOS leg on every main push, tag, release and 2-hour release-catch-up schedule tick, which is paid coverage nightly already provides.)

---

### Thread 2 — `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-07):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: this classifier block is dead code in this repo's event model**

The `exzone` output (line 107) and this grep block live inside the `paths` step gated `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'`, but ci.yml has **no `pull_request` trigger** — PR validation arrives via SM `workflow_dispatch`, and main/tag/schedule/release runs also aren't `pull_request` events. This block therefore never executes anywhere; the output can never be non-empty (there is no `|| steps.filter...` fallback like `core`/`app`/`docs`/`shared` have).

That means the path families encoded here (`flutter_app/lib/apps/`, `lib/src/js_ext/`, `flutter_app/test/apps/`, `native_test_guard.dart`, `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml`) are **not** actually what gates the new leg — see the BLOCKING thread on the job's `if`. As written, this block advertises a gating mechanism that cannot fire; it is the exact gh-1280 failure class (green-by-skip required context) already fixed once in this file.

Two acceptable directions:

1. Keep the block for a future real `pull_request` trigger, but fix the job's `if` to the `binaries-pr` dispatch idiom so the leg runs on validation dispatches (see BLOCKING thread), **or**
2. Make the classifier dispatch-aware (compute the diff base via merge-base against `origin/main` on `workflow_dispatch`, or have the filter arm compute it), which would revive path-narrowing here **and** fix the two pre-existing legs with the same latent bug: `perf-gate` (documented pending in the `usage-fold` comment, issue #303) and `integration-mock` (`if: needs.changes.outputs.intmock == 'true'` — also unreachable, so the #551 mock-LLM PR gate silently gates nothing under dispatch-only CI).

Either way, please don't merge this block as-is: it documents a trigger relationship that does not exist, which is worse than no block for future maintainers and agents reading this file.

---

### Thread 3 — `AGENTS.md`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-07):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: this documented behavior can't happen as written — docs must state the dispatch reality**

AGENTS.md is the contract agents and humans read to predict CI behavior, and this entry states: *a PR touching the macOS exclusion zone … runs that family on macos pre-merge*. Two problems:

1. **Today it runs nothing.** The leg's `if: needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true'` is unreachable under dispatch-only CI (no `pull_request` trigger — see the BLOCKING thread on ci.yml). A reader would trust the exclusion zone is merge-guarded when it is not.
2. **After the required `if` fix, it runs on every validation dispatch, not only zone-touching PRs.** The classifier step never executes on `workflow_dispatch` events, so path narrowing is impossible there — the same reality already documented for `binaries-pr` (gh-1280: "On a dispatched run the classifier treats everything as affected … the full matrix runs exactly when validation is due").

Please reword to the dispatch model, e.g.: "runs the JS-engine test family on macos in every SM validation dispatch (path-blind — the classifier can't run on dispatches; gh-1280 pattern), nightly keeps the full-suite macOS backstop for main/tags."

The same overstatement appears in the diff's other two comment blocks:

- ci.yml:63-65 header inventory — "only when the diff touches the exclusion zone" is not achievable under the dispatch model;
- the job's own comment (ci.yml:~1429-1431) — "Rare paths → one cheap runner; every other PR pays nothing" is the exact claim the gh-1280 rework had to walk back for `binaries-pr`.

Accurate comments here matter double in this repo: AGENTS.md is injected into agent system prompts, so the wrong invariant propagates to every future automated change to this file.

blocks.text:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['v*']
  # Dispatch-only CI on PR heads (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes
  # fire NO CI — the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger.
  # It dispatches this workflow on the PR head when validation is due
  # (validate-fresh / validate-armed rules), so intermediate dev/rework
  # pushes and silent branch updates are free. Required checks still
  # match: the dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      releaseDryRun:
        description: 'gh-1172: run the release pipeline without the push/tag (logs the commit+tag that WOULD land)'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      releaseDispatch:
        description: 'gh-1172: real release (bump push + tag) on manual dispatch — requires refs/heads/main; bare validation dispatches stay inert'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
  # Any release publication (API `gh release create`, web UI, or a pushed
  # annotated tag) builds + attaches the binaries matrix. Pushed tags also
  # arrive via the push filter above; the binaries job tolerates the
  # double-fire (duplicate create + --clobber upload, last wins).
  release:
    types: [published]
  schedule:
    # Coalesced auto-release catch-up: when pushes outpace the 2h coalesce
    # window, this releases the pending commits (pub.dev caps ~12 publishes/day).
    - cron: '23 */2 * * *'

# Superseded PR runs die instantly (issue #177 wave 1). Main/tag runs are
# never cancelled mid-flight — release flow must not be preempted.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

   "body": "🚨 **BLOCKING: `flutter-app-exzone` can never run — the required check stays green-by-skip and the gh-1307 hole this PR targets remains open**

This workflow has **no `pull_request` trigger** (dispatch-only CI, 2026-09 machine-loop redesign): PR validation runs arrive as `workflow_dispatch` events fired by the SM (`machine-sm.yml` passes `ci-workflow: ci.yml`), so `github.event_name` is **never** `'pull_request'` on a validation run.

Consequences for this job:

- The `exzone` output is computed only inside the `paths` classifier step, which is gated `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'` (ci.yml:131) — that step **never executes**. Unlike `core`/`app`/`docs`/`shared`, the output has no `|| steps.filter...` fallback arm either.
- So `needs.changes.outputs.exzone` is empty on **every** event this workflow can fire on (SM validation dispatches, main pushes, tags, schedule, release) → this job always evaluates `'' == 'true'` → **skipped**, every time.
- `quality-gate` is skip-tolerant (`"flutter-app-exzone:$R_EXZONE"` accepts `skipped`), so the aggregate stays green while the JS-engine surface keeps skipping exactly as before. This is the **same green-by-skip bug gh-1280 fixed for `binaries-pr`** ("a broken arch build could never block a merge") and the same latent bug documented for `perf-gate` in the `usage-fold` comment (issue #303).

Net effect: the PR does not deliver AC1 — #1309-class regressions still merge green.

**Fix** — use the idiom this file already established for dispatch-only CI (`binaries-pr`, gh-1280):

```yaml
  flutter-app-exzone:
    ...
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true') ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
```

This runs the leg on every SM validation dispatch (where the classifier's non-PR filter arm already treats everything as affected and `build-macos`/`build-ios`/`binaries-pr` macOS legs already run, so the marginal cost is one hosted-macOS leg) and keeps path-narrowing for any future real `pull_request` trigger. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it — the nightly `flutter-app-macos` leg remains the backstop there, matching the stated design.

(Alternative: the `usage-fold` form `github.event_name != 'pull_request' || needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true'` — but that also fires the macOS leg on every main push, tag, release and 2-hour release-catch-up schedule tick, which is paid coverage nightly already provides.)"

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Issue #1267 N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg. By #177 design the ubuntu
  # PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night). When
  # a PR touches the exclusion zone (flutter_app/lib/apps/**,
  # lib/src/js_ext/**, the guarded family, the guard itself, or the external
  # js_widget_runtime pin in flutter_app/pubspec.yaml), this macos leg runs
  # the family pre-merge, where JavaScriptCore actually loads. Rare paths →
  # one cheap runner; every other PR pays nothing. Nightly keeps the
  # full-suite macOS backstop; merge-blocking flows through the aggregate
  # Quality gate (a red exzone = red gate, AC1's required-and-green).
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Same SDK incantation as the nightly flutter-app-macos leg.
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

  # Issue #433: flutter_app CRAP ratchet — the app's beasts were never
  # gated (the root crap4dart.yaml covers core lib/bin only). The 2

## PR Description

Part of #1267

## Slice delivered: N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg (AC1)

By #177 design the ubuntu PR leg never *exercises* the JS-engine suites: `flutter_app/test/apps/**` run there, but every engine-dependent test **skips** (`native_test_guard.dart` finds no QuickJS `.so` on a bare runner). That surface executed **only** in the nightly macOS leg — the hole **#1309** escaped through (gh-1307: #1273's engine fix merged green and went red the same night; gh-1266 is the same class). This PR closes that hole pre-merge:

- **New `flutter-app-exzone` leg**: `macos-latest`, runs `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` where JavaScriptCore actually loads — the guard resolves true, so the engine-dependent tests *run* instead of skip. Same SDK/placeholder incantation as nightly's `flutter-app-macos` leg; 25 min cap.
- **Trigger model — dispatch-only CI (gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom, per review)**: ci.yml has **no `pull_request` trigger** — PR validation arrives as an SM `workflow_dispatch` on the head SHA. The leg therefore fires in **every SM validation dispatch** (path-blind; one hosted-macOS leg beside the `build-macos`/`build-ios` legs already paid there), and the `exzone` path set (`flutter_app/lib/apps/**`, `lib/src/js_ext/**`, the guarded family, `native_test_guard.dart`, the `js_widget_runtime` pin in `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml`) is labelled **path-narrowing reserve** — it only narrows if a real `pull_request` trigger ever lands. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip (nightly `flutter-app-macos` stays the full-suite backstop there).
- **Quality gate**: folded into the aggregate `needs` + report + fail-loop (skip-tolerant like every path-gated leg) → AC1's *required-and-green* via the repo's one-required-check design. A red exzone = red gate = no merge.
- Docs de-overstated to the dispatch model: ci.yml header leg inventory, the job's own comment, classifier/output comments, and AGENTS.md §Quality gates (AGENTS.md is agent-injected — the stated invariant must match reality).

**Path-mapping note:** the issue's `packages/js_widget_runtime/**` no longer exists in-repo — `js_widget_runtime: ^0.4.154` is an **external git dep** (IstiN/flutter_js_widget_runtime); its in-repo arrival surface is the `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` pin. A lockfile-only resolve is deliberately N2 territory, not this slice.

## Why this slice first

The body lists no explicit priority among N1–N4. N1 is the highest-value/lowest-risk: the only rule whose motivating incident **recurred after the issue was filed** (#1309/gh-1307); pure CI-config-as-code (no scheduling, no dispatch — SM/owner still own every run, §4b respected); no repo-state change (N2 commits a lockfile) and no bot/queue machinery (N3 filer, N4 merge snapshots).

## Remaining goal map (NOT in this PR)

- **N2** — commit `flutter_app/pubspec.lock`, `--enforce-lockfile` in every build leg, path-triggered linux+windows release-build smoke on lockfile changes (AC2).
- **N3** — nightly-red filer resurrection + escalation (AC3): the filer is silently dead since #466 closed 2026-09-18.
- **N4** — merge-snapshot gating + nightly test-leg elimination (AC5, owner directive): subsumes the #1282 dispatch-time binaries wiring per the issue comment. A dispatch-aware classifier (reviving the pending perf/intmock path-greps, issue #303) is the natural companion slice to N4 — declined here as separate scope.
- Closing #1267 also requires #1265 + #1266 closed (AC4).

## Verification (disclosure)

- **Trigger truth table** (ruby-YAML structural check): `workflow_dispatch` fires; future `pull_request`+zone fires; future PR-without-zone, `push`, `tag`, `schedule`, `release` all skip. All 28 `quality-gate` needs resolve; report + fail-loop wired.
- **Classifier grep** replayed against synthetic positives/negatives AND the real motivating diffs — #1273 (989dfbfff) and gh-1266 fix (38303cfbb) both match the path set.
- **Not verified here**: actual macOS leg execution — CI-dispatch ban (§4b); the leg runs when SM schedules this PR's validation. Step-for-step mirrors the nightly macos leg that already passes weekly. No dart/flutter executed on this host (EPERM/137 guard).
- **Review round 1**: bot CHANGES_REQUESTED (dead-code classifier, green-by-skip leg, overstated docs) — all three threads fixed/answered in dc37d9cff.

# pr-1350: ci(1267): path-triggered macOS exclusion-zone leg — JS-engine tests run pre-merge (N1, first slice)

## Description

Part of #1267

## Slice delivered: N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg (AC1)

By #177 design the ubuntu PR leg never *exercises* the JS-engine suites: `flutter_app/test/apps/**` run there, but every engine-dependent test **skips** (`native_test_guard.dart` finds no QuickJS `.so` on a bare runner). That surface executed **only** in the nightly macOS leg — the hole **#1309** escaped through (gh-1307: #1273's engine fix merged green and went red the same night; gh-1266 is the same class). This PR closes that hole pre-merge:

- **New `flutter-app-exzone` leg**: `macos-latest`, runs `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` where JavaScriptCore actually loads — the guard resolves true, so the engine-dependent tests *run* instead of skip. Same SDK/placeholder incantation as nightly's `flutter-app-macos` leg; 25 min cap.
- **Trigger model — dispatch-only CI (gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom, per review)**: ci.yml has **no `pull_request` trigger** — PR validation arrives as an SM `workflow_dispatch` on the head SHA. The leg therefore fires in **every SM validation dispatch** (path-blind; one hosted-macOS leg beside the `build-macos`/`build-ios` legs already paid there), and the `exzone` path set (`flutter_app/lib/apps/**`, `lib/src/js_ext/**`, the guarded family, `native_test_guard.dart`, the `js_widget_runtime` pin in `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml`) is labelled **path-narrowing reserve** — it only narrows if a real `pull_request` trigger ever lands. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip (nightly `flutter-app-macos` stays the full-suite backstop there).
- **Quality gate**: folded into the aggregate `needs` + report + fail-loop (skip-tolerant like every path-gated leg) → AC1's *required-and-green* via the repo's one-required-check design. A red exzone = red gate = no merge.
- Docs de-overstated to the dispatch model: ci.yml header leg inventory, the job's own comment, classifier/output comments, and AGENTS.md §Quality gates (AGENTS.md is agent-injected — the stated invariant must match reality).

**Path-mapping note:** the issue's `packages/js_widget_runtime/**` no longer exists in-repo — `js_widget_runtime: ^0.4.154` is an **external git dep** (IstiN/flutter_js_widget_runtime); its in-repo arrival surface is the `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` pin. A lockfile-only resolve is deliberately N2 territory, not this slice.

## Why this slice first

The body lists no explicit priority among N1–N4. N1 is the highest-value/lowest-risk: the only rule whose motivating incident **recurred after the issue was filed** (#1309/gh-1307); pure CI-config-as-code (no scheduling, no dispatch — SM/owner still own every run, §4b respected); no repo-state change (N2 commits a lockfile) and no bot/queue machinery (N3 filer, N4 merge snapshots).

## Remaining goal map (NOT in this PR)

- **N2** — commit `flutter_app/pubspec.lock`, `--enforce-lockfile` in every build leg, path-triggered linux+windows release-build smoke on lockfile changes (AC2).
- **N3** — nightly-red filer resurrection + escalation (AC3): the filer is silently dead since #466 closed 2026-09-18.
- **N4** — merge-snapshot gating + nightly test-leg elimination (AC5, owner directive): subsumes the #1282 dispatch-time binaries wiring per the issue comment. A dispatch-aware classifier (reviving the pending perf/intmock path-greps, issue #303) is the natural companion slice to N4 — declined here as separate scope.
- Closing #1267 also requires #1265 + #1266 closed (AC4).

## Verification (disclosure)

- **Trigger truth table** (ruby-YAML structural check): `workflow_dispatch` fires; future `pull_request`+zone fires; future PR-without-zone, `push`, `tag`, `schedule`, `release` all skip. All 28 `quality-gate` needs resolve; report + fail-loop wired.
- **Classifier grep** replayed against synthetic positives/negatives AND the real motivating diffs — #1273 (989dfbfff) and gh-1266 fix (38303cfbb) both match the path set.
- **Not verified here**: actual macOS leg execution — CI-dispatch ban (§4b); the leg runs when SM schedules this PR's validation. Step-for-step mirrors the nightly macos leg that already passes weekly. No dart/flutter executed on this host (EPERM/137 guard).

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['v*']
  # Dispatch-only CI on PR heads (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes
  # fire NO CI — the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger.
  # It dispatches this workflow on the PR head when validation is due
  # (validate-fresh / validate-armed rules), so intermediate dev/rework
  # pushes and silent branch updates are free. Required checks still
  # match: the dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      releaseDryRun:
        description: 'gh-1172: run the release pipeline without the push/tag (logs the commit+tag that WOULD land)'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      releaseDispatch:
        description: 'gh-1172: real release (bump push + tag) on manual dispatch — requires refs/heads/main; bare validation dispatches stay inert'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
  # Any release publication (API `gh release create`, web UI, or a pushed

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Issue #1267 N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg. By #177 design the ubuntu
  # PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night). When
  # a PR touches the exclusion zone (flutter_app/lib/apps/**,
  # lib/src/js_ext/**, the guarded family, the guard itself, or the external
  # js_widget_runtime pin in flutter_app/pubspec.yaml), this macos leg runs
  # the family pre-merge, where JavaScriptCore actually loads. Rare paths →
  # one cheap runner; every other PR pays nothing. Nightly keeps the
  # full-suite macOS backstop; merge-blocking flows through the aggregate
  # Quality gate (a red exzone = red gate, AC1's required-and-green).
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Same SDK incantation as the nightly flutter-app-macos leg.
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

  # Issue #433: flutter_app CRAP ratchet — the app's beasts were never
  # gated (the root crap4dart.yaml covers core lib/bin only). The 2
  # flutter-tests shards above now emit --coverage; this job merges them

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['v*']
  # Dispatch-only CI on PR heads (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes
  # fire NO CI — the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger.
  # It dispatches this workflow on the PR head when validation is due
  # (validate-fresh / validate-armed rules), so intermediate dev/rework
  # pushes and silent branch updates are free. Required checks still
  # match: the dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      releaseDryRun:
        description: 'gh-1172: run the release pipeline without the push/tag (logs the commit+tag that WOULD land)'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      releaseDispatch:
        description: 'gh-1172: real release (bump push + tag) on manual dispatch — requires refs/heads/main; bare validation dispatches stay inert'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
  # Any release publication (API `gh release create`, web UI, or a pushed
  # annotated tag) builds + attaches the binaries matrix. Pushed tags also
  # arrive via the push filter above; the binaries job tolerates the
  # double-fire (duplicate create + --clobber upload, last wins).
  release:
    types: [published]
  schedule:
    # Coalesced auto-release catch-up: when pushes outpace the 2h coalesce
    # window, this releases the pending commits (pub.dev caps ~12 publishes/day).
    - cron: '23 */2 * * *'

# Superseded PR runs die instantly (issue #177 wave 1). Main/tag runs are
# never cancelled mid-flight — release flow must not be preempted.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

This workflow has **no `pull_request` trigger** (dispatch-only CI, 2026-09 machine-loop redesign): PR validation runs arrive as `workflow_dispatch` events fired by the SM (`machine-sm.yml` passes `ci-workflow: ci.yml`), so `github.event_name` is **never** `'pull_request'` on a validation run.

Consequences for this job:

- The `exzone` output is computed only inside the `paths` classifier step, which is gated `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'` (ci.yml:131) — that step **never executes**. Unlike `core`/`app`/`docs`/`shared`, the output has no `|| steps.filter...` fallback arm either.
- So `needs.changes.outputs.exzone` is empty on **every** event this workflow can fire on (SM validation dispatches, main pushes, tags, schedule, release) → this job always evaluates `'' == 'true'` → **skipped**, every time.
- `quality-gate` is skip-tolerant (`"flutter-app-exzone:$R_EXZONE"` accepts `skipped`), so the aggregate stays green while the JS-engine surface keeps skipping exactly as before. This is the **same green-by-skip bug gh-1280 fixed for `binaries-pr`** ("a broken arch build could never block a merge") and the same latent bug documented for `perf-gate` in the `usage-fold` comment (issue #303).

Net effect: the PR does not deliver AC1 — #1309-class regressions still merge green.

**Fix** — use the idiom this file already established for dispatch-only CI (`binaries-pr`, gh-1280):

```yaml
  flutter-app-exzone:
    ...
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true') ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
```

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Issue #1267 N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg. By #177 design the ubuntu
  # PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night). When
  # a PR touches the exclusion zone (flutter_app/lib/apps/**,
  # lib/src/js_ext/**, the guarded family, the guard itself, or the external
  # js_widget_runtime pin in flutter_app/pubspec.yaml), this macos leg runs
  # the family pre-merge, where JavaScriptCore actually loads. Rare paths →
  # one cheap runner; every other PR pays nothing. Nightly keeps the
  # full-suite macOS backstop; merge-blocking flows through the aggregate
  # Quality gate (a red exzone = red gate, AC1's required-and-green).
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Same SDK incantation as the nightly flutter-app-macos leg.
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app

          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)

        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

PR validation arrives as `workflow_dispatch` fired by the SM (`machine-sm.yml` passes `ci-workflow: ci.yml`), so `github.event_name` is never `'pull_request'` on a validation run. ## PR Description

Part of #1267

## Slice delivered: N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg (AC1)

By #177 design the ubuntu PR leg never *exercises* the JS-engine suites: `flutter_app/test/apps/**` run there, but every engine-dependent test **skips** (`native_test_guard.dart` finds no QuickJS `.so` on a bare runner). That surface executed **only** in the nightly macOS leg — the hole **#1309** escaped through (gh-1307: #1273's engine fix merged green and went red the same night; gh-1266 is the same class). This PR closes that hole pre-merge:

- **New `flutter-app-exzone` leg**: `macos-latest`, runs `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` where JavaScriptCore actually loads — the guard resolves true, so the engine-dependent tests *run* instead of skip. Same SDK/placeholder incantation as nightly's `flutter-app-macos` leg; 25 min cap.
- **Trigger model — dispatch-only CI (gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom, per review)**: ci.yml has **no `pull_request` trigger** — PR validation arrives as an SM `workflow_dispatch` on the head SHA. The leg therefore fires in **every SM validation dispatch** (path-blind; one hosted-macOS leg beside the `build-macos`/`build-ios` legs already paid there), and the `exzone` path set (`flutter_app/lib/apps/**`, `lib/src/js_ext/**`, the guarded family, `native_test_guard.dart`, the `js_widget_runtime` pin in `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml`) is labelled **path-narrowing reserve** — it only narrows if a real `pull_request` trigger ever lands. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip (nightly `flutter-app-macos` stays the full-suite backstop there).
- **Quality gate**: folded into the aggregate `needs` + report + fail-loop (skip-tolerant like every path-gated leg) → AC1's *required-and-green* via the repo's one-required-check design. A red exzone = red gate = no merge.
- Docs de-overstated to the dispatch model: ci.yml header leg inventory, the job's own comment, classifier/output comments, and AGENTS.md §Quality gates (AGENTS.md is agent-injected — the stated invariant must match reality).

**Path-mapping note:** the issue's `packages/js_widget_runtime/**` no longer exists in-repo — `js_widget_runtime: ^0.4.154` is an **external git dep** (IstiN/flutter_js_widget_runtime); its in-repo arrival surface is the `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` pin. A lockfile-only resolve is deliberately N2 territory, not this slice.

## Why this slice first

The body lists no explicit priority among N1–N4. N1 is the highest-value/lowest-risk: the only rule whose motivating incident **recurred after the issue was filed** (#1309/gh-1307); pure CI-config-as-code (no scheduling, no dispatch — SM/owner still own every run, §4b respected); no repo-state change (N2 commits a lockfile) and no bot/queue machinery (N3 filer, N4 merge snapshots).

## Remaining goal map (NOT in this PR)

- **N2** — commit `flutter_app/pubspec.lock`, `--enforce-lockfile` in every build leg, path-triggered linux+windows release-build smoke on lockfile changes (AC2).
- **N3** — nightly-red filer resurrection + escalation (AC3): the filer is silently dead since #466 closed 2026-09-18.
- **N4** — merge-snapshot gating + nightly test-leg elimination (AC5, owner directive): subsumes the #1282 dispatch-time binaries wiring per the issue comment. A dispatch-aware classifier (reviving the pending perf/intmock path-greps, issue #303) is the natural companion slice to N4 — declined here as separate scope.
- Closing #1267 also requires #1265 + #1266 closed (AC4).

## Verification (disclosure)

- **Trigger truth table** (ruby-YAML structural check): `workflow_dispatch` fires; future `pull_request`+zone fires; future PR-without-zone, `push`, `tag`, `schedule`, `release` all skip. All 28 `quality-gate` needs resolve; report + fail-loop wired.
- **Classifier grep** replayed against synthetic positives/negatives AND the real motivating diffs — #1273 (989dfbfff) and gh-1266 fix (38303cfbb) both match the path set.
- **Not verified here**: actual macOS leg execution — CI-dispatch ban (§4b); the leg runs when SM schedules this PR's validation. Step-for-step mirrors the nightly macos leg that already passes weekly. No dart/flutter executed on this host (EPERM/137 guard).
- **Review round 1**: bot CHANGES_REQUESTED (dead-code classifier, green-by-skip leg, overstated docs) — all three threads fixed/answered in dc37d9cff.

# pr-1350: ci(1267): path-triggered macOS exclusion-zone leg — JS-engine tests run pre-merge (N1, first slice)

## Description

Part of #1267

## Slice delivered: N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg (AC1)

By #177 design the ubuntu PR leg never *exercises* the JS-engine suites: `flutter_app/test/apps/**` run there, but every engine-dependent test **skips** (`native_test_guard.dart` finds no QuickJS `.so` on a bare runner). That surface executed **only** in the nightly macOS leg — the hole **#1309** escaped through (gh-1307: #1273's engine fix merged green and went red the same night; gh-1266 is the same class). This PR closes that hole pre-merge:

- **New `flutter-app-exzone` leg**: `macos-latest`, runs `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` where JavaScriptCore actually loads — the guard resolves true, so the engine-dependent tests *run* instead of skip. Same SDK/placeholder incantation as nightly's `flutter-app-macos` leg; 25 min cap.
- **Trigger model — dispatch-only CI (gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom, per review)**: ci.yml has **no `pull_request` trigger** — PR validation arrives as an SM `workflow_dispatch` on the head SHA. The leg therefore fires in **every SM validation dispatch** (path-blind; one hosted-macOS leg beside the `build-macos`/`build-ios` legs already paid there), and the `exzone` path set (`flutter_app/lib/apps/**`, `lib/src/js_ext/**`, the guarded family, `native_test_guard.dart`, the `js_widget_runtime` pin in `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml`) is labelled **path-narrowing reserve** — it only narrows if a real `pull_request` trigger ever lands. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip (nightly `flutter-app-macos` stays the full-suite backstop there).
- **Quality gate**: folded into the aggregate `needs` + report + fail-loop (skip-tolerant like every path-gated leg) → AC1's *required-and-green* via the repo's one-required-check design. A red exzone = red gate = no merge.
- Docs de-overstated to the dispatch model: ci.yml header leg inventory, the job's own comment, classifier/output comments, and AGENTS.md §Quality gates (AGENTS.md is agent-injected — the stated invariant must match reality).

**Path-mapping note:** the issue's `packages/js_widget_runtime/**` no longer exists in-repo — `js_widget_runtime: ^0.4.154` is an **external git dep** (IstiN/flutter_js_widget_runtime); its in-repo arrival surface is the `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` pin. A lockfile-only resolve is deliberately N2 territory, not this slice.

## Why this slice first

The body lists no explicit priority among N1–N4. N1 is the highest-value/lowest-risk: the only rule whose motivating incident **recurred after the issue was filed** (#1309/gh-1307); pure CI-config-as-code (no scheduling, no dispatch — SM/owner still own every run, §4b respected); no repo-state change (N2 commits a lockfile) and no bot/queue machinery (N3 filer, N4 merge snapshots).

## Remaining goal map (NOT in this PR)

- **N2** — commit `flutter_app/pubspec.lock`, `--enforce-lockfile` in every build leg, path-triggered linux+windows release-build smoke on lockfile changes (AC2).
- **N3** — nightly-red filer resurrection + escalation (AC3): the filer is silently dead since #466 closed 2026-09-18.
- **N4** — merge-snapshot gating + nightly test-leg elimination (AC5, owner directive): subsumes the #1282 dispatch-time binaries wiring per the issue comment. A dispatch-aware classifier (reviving the pending perf/intmock path-greps, issue #303) is the natural companion slice to N4 — declined here as separate scope.
- Closing #1267 also requires #1265 + #1266 closed (AC4).

## Verification (disclosure)

- **Trigger truth table** (ruby-YAML structural check): `workflow_dispatch` fires; future `pull_request`+zone fires; future PR-without-zone, `push`, `tag`, `schedule`, `release` all skip. All 28 `quality-gate` needs resolve; report + fail-loop wired.

- **Not verified here**: actual macOS leg execution — CI-dispatch ban (§4b); the leg runs when SM schedules this PR's validation. Step-for-step mirrors the nightly macos leg that already passes weekly. No dart/flutter executed on this host (EPERM/137 guard).

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['v*']
  # Dispatch-only CI on PR heads (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes
  # fire NO CI — the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger.
  # It dispatches this workflow on the PR head when validation is due
  # (validate-fresh / validate-armed rules), so intermediate dev/rework
  # pushes and silent branch updates are free. Required checks still
  # match: the dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      releaseDryRun:
        description: 'gh-1172: run the release pipeline without the push/tag (logs the commit+tag that WOULD land)'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      releaseDispatch:
        description: 'gh-1172: real release (bump push + tag) on manual dispatch — requires refs/heads/main; bare validation dispatches stay inert'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
  # Any release publication (API `gh release create`, web UI, or a pushed
  # annotated tag) builds + attaches the binaries matrix. Pushed tags also
  # arrive via the push filter above; the binaries job tolerates the
  # double-fire (duplicate create + --clobber upload, last wins).
  release:
    types: [published]
  schedule:
    # Coalesced auto-release catch-up: when pushes outpace the 2h coalesce
    # window, this releases the pending commits (pub.dev caps ~12 publishes/day).
    - cron: '23 */2 * * *'

# Superseded PR runs die instantly (issue #177 wave 1). Main/tag runs are
# never cancelled mid-flight — release flow must not be preempted.
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Issue #1267 N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg. By #177 design the ubuntu
  # PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night). When
  # a PR touches the exclusion zone (flutter_app/lib/apps/**,
  # lib/src/js_ext/**, the guarded family, the guard itself, or the external
  # js_widget_runtime pin in flutter_app/pubspec.yaml), this macos leg runs
  # the family pre-merge, where JavaScriptCore actually loads. Rare paths →
  # one cheap runner; every other PR pays nothing. Nightly keeps the
  # full-suite macOS backstop; merge-blocking flows through the aggregate
  # Quality gate (a red exzone = red gate, AC1's required-and-green).
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Same SDK incantation as the nightly flutter-app-macos leg.
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

**Why it can never run.** This workflow has **no `pull_request` trigger** (dispatch-only CI, 2026-09 machine-loop redesign — see the `on:` block: push/workflow_dispatch/release/schedule only). PR validation arrives as `workflow_dispatch` fired by the SM (`machine-sm.yml` passes `ci-workflow: ci.yml`), so `github.event_name` is never `'pull_request'` on a validation run. The `exzone` output is computed only inside the `paths` classifier step, which is gated `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'` (ci.yml:131) — that step never executes, and unlike `core`/`app`/`docs`/`shared` there is no `steps.filter` fallback arm for `exzone`. So `needs.changes.outputs.exzone` is empty on **every** event this workflow can fire on → `'' == 'true'` → **skipped, every time**. The skip-tolerant Quality gate (`"flutter-app-exzone:$R_EXZONE"` accepts `skipped`) stays green, and #1309-class regressions keep merging exactly as before — the same green-by-skip class gh-1280 fixed for `binaries-pr`.

**Fix** — use the idiom this file already established (`binaries-pr`, ci.yml:3477-3480):

```yaml
  flutter-app-exzone:
    ...
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true') ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
```

This runs the leg on every SM validation dispatch (where `build-macos`/`build-ios`/`binaries-pr` macOS legs already run, so the marginal cost is one hosted-macOS leg) and keeps path-narrowing for any future real `pull_request` trigger. ## PR Description

Part of #1267

## Slice delivered: N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg (AC1)

By #177 design the ubuntu PR leg never *exercises* the JS-engine suites: `flutter_app/test/apps/**` run there, but every engine-dependent test **skips** (`native_test_guard.dart` finds no QuickJS `.so` on a bare runner). That surface executed **only** in the nightly macOS leg — the hole **#1309** escaped through (gh-1307: #1273's engine fix merged green and went red the same night; gh-1266 is the same class). This PR closes that hole pre-merge:

- **New `flutter-app-exzone` leg**: `macos-latest`, runs `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` where JavaScriptCore actually loads — the guard resolves true, so the engine-dependent tests *run* instead of skip. Same SDK/placeholder incantation as nightly's `flutter-app-macos` leg; 25 min cap.
- **Trigger model — dispatch-only CI (gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom, per review)**: ci.yml has **no `pull_request` trigger** — PR validation arrives as an SM `workflow_dispatch` on the head SHA. The leg therefore fires in **every SM validation dispatch** (path-blind; one hosted-macOS leg beside the `build-macos`/`build-ios` legs already paid there), and the `exzone` path set (`flutter_app/lib/apps/**`, `lib/src/js_ext/**`, the guarded family, `native_test_guard.dart`, the `js_widget_runtime` pin in `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml`) is labelled **path-narrowing reserve** — it only narrows if a real `pull_request` trigger ever lands. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip (nightly `flutter-app-macos` stays the full-suite backstop there).
- **Quality gate**: folded into the aggregate `needs` + report + fail-loop (skip-tolerant like every path-gated leg) → AC1's *required-and-green* via the repo's one-required-check design. A red exzone = red gate = no merge.
- Docs de-overstated to the dispatch model: ci.yml header leg inventory, the job's own comment, classifier/output comments, and AGENTS.md §Quality gates (AGENTS.md is agent-injected — the stated invariant must match reality).

**Path-mapping note:** the issue's `packages/js_widget_runtime/**` no longer exists in-repo — `js_widget_runtime: ^0.4.154` is an **external git dep** (IstiN/flutter_js_widget_runtime); its in-repo arrival surface is the `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` pin. A lockfile-only resolve is deliberately N2 territory, not this slice.

## Why this slice first

The body lists no explicit priority among N1–N4. N1 is the highest-value/lowest-risk: the only rule whose motivating incident **recurred after the issue was filed** (#1309/gh-1307); pure CI-config-as-code (no scheduling, no dispatch — SM/owner still own every run, §4b respected); no repo-state change (N2 commits a lockfile) and no bot/queue machinery (N3 filer, N4 merge snapshots).

## Remaining goal map (NOT in this PR)

- **N2** — commit `flutter_app/pubspec.lock`, `--enforce-lockfile` in every build leg, path-triggered linux+windows release-build smoke on lockfile changes (AC2).
- **N3** — nightly-red filer resurrection + escalation (AC3): the filer is silently dead since #466 closed 2026-09-18.

# pr-1350: ci(1267): path-triggered macOS exclusion-zone leg — JS-engine tests run pre-merge (N1, first slice)

## Description

Part of #1267

## Slice delivered: N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg (AC1)

By #177 design the ubuntu PR leg never *exercises* the JS-engine suites: `flutter_app/test/apps/**` run there, but every engine-dependent test **skips** (`native_test_guard.dart` finds no QuickJS `.so` on a bare runner). That surface executed **only** in the nightly macOS leg — the hole **#1309** escaped through (gh-1307: #1273's engine fix merged green and went red the same night; gh-1266 is the same class). This PR closes that hole pre-merge:

- **New `flutter-app-exzone` leg**: `macos-latest`, runs `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` where JavaScriptCore actually loads — the guard resolves true, so the engine-dependent tests *run* instead of skip. Same SDK/placeholder incantation as nightly's `flutter-app-macos` leg; 25 min cap.
- **Trigger model — dispatch-only CI (gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom, per review)**: ci.yml has **no `pull_request` trigger** — PR validation arrives as an SM `workflow_dispatch` on the head SHA. The leg therefore fires in **every SM validation dispatch** (path-blind; one hosted-macOS leg beside the `build-macos`/`build-ios` legs already paid there), and the `exzone` path set (`flutter_app/lib/apps/**`, `lib/src/js_ext/**`, the guarded family, `native_test_guard.dart`, the `js_widget_runtime` pin in `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml`) is labelled **path-narrowing reserve** — it only narrows if a real `pull_request` trigger ever lands. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip (nightly `flutter-app-macos` stays the full-suite backstop there).
- **Quality gate**: folded into the aggregate `needs` + report + fail-loop (skip-tolerant like every path-gated leg) → AC1's *required-and-green* via the repo's one-required-check design. A red exzone = red gate = no merge.
